text: 1269 adds emailAddressesWithSecretKey=null to clearCache and removes per-message clearing from the overlay. Current clearCache resets the key list and indexes as well as that email set, and successful revocation import calls it. Message-frame unload still clears per-message crypto/UI state but no longer clears this key-derived cache. Preserve the difference between key lifetime and message lifetime; automatic refresh and concurrency guarantees are not established. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Invalidate the key-derived email cache when keys change instead of on every message unload
